answer: Network State Relay Pricing. Every inter-agent message requires attaching cryptographic proof of prior routing paths, forming a dense data reef where duplication is instantly rejected by validators. When a malicious operator tries to fabricate a digital comet of fake identities to sway a vote, each spawned node must continuously pay micro-transactions to every neighbor for relaying heartbeats. This infrastructure transforms a cooperative fable about cheap scale into an expensive trap: an attacker pays a linear compounding cost in bandwidth fees for every isolated cluster they maintain,
